name: PolicyKit
tagline: An open-source tool for evolving governance in online communities
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on academic institution (University of Washington) for maintenance
Dependency on community platform APIs (Slack, Discord, etc.)
outcome_methodology: case studies and user feedback from deployed communities
published_performance_metrics: community engagement metrics, policy adoption rates in pilot communities
documented_limitations: Limited to online communities with existing platform integrations
Requires technical setup and API access
failure_modes: API deprecation or changes by platform providers
Low adoption in communities without technical capacity
Governance deadlock in policy voting mechanisms
curation_criteria: open-source contribution guidelines, peer review for policy implementations
contributor_governance: University of Washington-led with community contributions via GitHub
community_ownership: limited - primarily academic-led with community input
political_relevance_summary: PolicyKit addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. An open-source tool for evolving governance in online communities.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure supporting civic technology ecosystem.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; already deployed across multiple jurisdictions; replication materials are available.
